verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy question for an AI assistant that holds memory and connected-account data, so the axis applies. The pack shows no retention settings, memory or message deletion, account deletion, or data export. The closest items, disconnecting an integration (poke-docs-33) and choosing which account's Memory survives a merge (poke-docs-20), revoke access or consolidate accounts rather than control retention or delete data.
